question: Which of the following organizations' headquarters is NOT correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is **OPEC- Zurich**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• OPEC (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries) is an intergovernmental organization oil demand supply market upstream downstream Vienna Austria
 
• Currently, the Organization comprises 15 Member Countries – namely **Algeria, Angola, Congo, Ecuador, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, IR Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Libya, Nigeria, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates and Venezuela**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** World Bank** is an international financial institution that provides loans and grants to the governments of low- and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects
 
• The **North Atlantic Treaty Organization is headquartered in a complex in Haren**, part of the City of Brussels municipality of Belgium.
 
• **UNICEF, in full originally called the United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund**, now officially United Nations Children's Fund, is an agency of the United Nations responsible for providing humanitarian and developmental aid to children worldwide
